title: Kansas City Local Emergency Operations Plan - Kansas City, United States of America
landscapes: Athletics, Healthcare, Household, Institutional, Mass Gatherings, Urban
description: The Kansas City Local Emergency Operations Plan (LEOP) was prepared by the Office of Emergency Management (OEM) and adopted by the City Council of Kansas City, Missouri.  It reflects recent developments in the field of emergency management, including lessons learned from recent disasters, and updates of the National Incident Management System (NIMS).
